title: dummyindex sessions list --json
description: Output of `dummyindex sessions list [--root DIR] --json` (new in the engine, not yet shipped). Read-only, bounded enrichment over ~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/ (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR overrides ~/.claude). Subagent children are items with agent_id and parent_session_id set. Unparseable data never fails the command: the session gets state unknown plus a warning. Session states follow the rules in docs/engine-contract.md section 8.

session_id.description: Claude Code sessionId, taken from the record field (not from the file name) and cross-checked against the parent folder for subagents.

agent_id.description: Subagent id (the agent-<agentId> file stem, without the agent- prefix). null for main sessions.

agent_type.description: meta.agentType of a subagent; null for main sessions.

parent_session_id.description: Parent session id for subagent children; null for main sessions.

cwd.description: Authoritative project path from the cwd field. Never derived from the folder name.

code.description: Open set. Examples: unparseable_line, unknown_state, missing_meta, missing_cwd.
